turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
If the shipment is already in transit, tracking gaps of 24–48 hours can be normal while it moves between carrier facilities. For SpeedX shipments, the first scan can take up to 72 business hours, excluding weekends, after the label is created.

If it’s been longer than that without an update, send your order number or the email used at checkout so I can check the shipment status here.

Thanks for being a Tumble customer; I'm here if you have any questions.
